newsitem.title: USA: NFL AMERICAN FOOTBALL-BEEBE FINALLY GETS HANDS ON SUPER BOWL TROPHY.
newsitem.headline: NFL AMERICAN FOOTBALL-BEEBE FINALLY GETS HANDS ON SUPER BOWL TROPHY.

text.p: Green Bay Packers receiver Don Beebe finally got his hands on the Super Bowl trophy on Sunday night and it was not immediately clear if he was ever going to let go.

"I've been wanting to hold this thing for a long time," said Beebe, clutching the Lombardi trophy in the winner's lockerroom shortly after the Packers beat the New England Patriots 35-21 in Super Bowl XXXI.
"And yes, I'm taking this thing home. These guys don't know that yet, but it's gonna sit on my mantel," joked a tremendously emotional Beebe.
Beebe had more reason to rejoice than most of his victorious teammates after losing four consecutive Super Bowls as a member of the Buffalo Bills.
"I just wish those guys could feel what I feel right now," he said of his good friends in Buffalo, fellow losers of Super Bowls XXV, XXVI, XXVII and XXVIII.
Beebe not only got to play for a Super Bowl winner, but he had the best view in the house for the most electrifying play of the game.
On Desmond Howard's sensational 99-yard kickoff return for a touchdown, which effectively put an end to New England's chances, Beebe led the charge up the field.
"I was leading him and I saw how big that hole was and I said, 'we're going to score.'
"All I had to do was get on the safety, put my helmet in his pads and then it's (Howard) and the kicker, and there's no way the kicker's going to tackle Desmond in the open field. It's impossible."
All the time Beebe was reliving the big play and marvelling at his good fortune, he never loosened his grip on the championship trophy.
"To think that I was going to play in five Super Bowls in eight years, that's crazy to even think about.
"And to finally, finally, finally experience what this bad boy (trophy) feels like. It's a little heavier that I thought it was."
